title: Alibaba Quark AI Glasses S1 / G1 launched in China (12 MP IMX681, f/2.2, 5P lens)

title: VR陀螺 review of Quark S1 mentions autofocus wording but not the focus mechanism
detail: VR陀螺 review: "大多数AI眼镜的拍摄对焦往往以「自动对焦」为主"; S1's capacitive shutter "通过波导镜片显示对焦标识" (shows a focus marker). The focus mechanism is not stated, so AF hardware is unknown.

title: 52audio teardown of Quark S1: IMX681, 5-element lens, no focus actuator mentioned
detail: 12 MP Sony IMX681, f/2.2, 109 degree, 5-element lens; TDK ICM-42688-P IMU used for stabilisation; manufacturer 浙江未来精灵人工智能科技有限公司. No focus actuator mentioned.
